data.standardized_narrative: The report images provided were partially legible. The syndicate recorded gross written premiums of 247.4 (native currency) in 2018 and references several 2018 catastrophe events (Hurricane Florence, Hurricane Michael and California wildfires). A clear, extractable gross prioryear reserve movement (the movement in the provision for claims outstanding for years prior to 2018) was not unambiguously identifiable from the supplied images, so no quantified prioryear strengthening or release is reported here. Detailed technical reserves tables and a claims development triangle appear present in the document images but could not be reliably parsed from the scans provided.
data.data_quality_notes: Document provided as images with low OCR/readability. Key figures requested by the template (gross opening claims outstanding at the start of the year and the gross prior-year development movement) could not be unambiguously located in the scanned pages. A gross written premium total of 247.4 (native currency millions) was readable on the technical account table (page ~12). Claims development triangles and detailed technical reserves reconciliation tables are present in the images but were not legible enough to extract reliable numeric prior-year movement or opening gross claims outstanding. All other numeric fields are left null to avoid guessing. If higher-resolution PDF pages or the original digital report are supplied I can extract the full reserves reconciliation, prior-year development (gross), per-LOB movements and the claims development triangle precisely.
